title: Teen Girls Learning Their Lesson The Hard Way
description:
While on patrol, officers noticed minors violating traffic laws and conducted a traffic stop. What they found beneath the driver's seat was extremely bad news for the occupants. Watch how she tries to deny that she's hiding anything from the cops. She'll regret it later. It was pretty evident from the girl's body language that she was trying to hide something from the police. They were trying really hard not to get in trouble, but the ship had already sailed. The officer had already gotten his hands on the prime evidence. Courtney was watching a nail-biting show from the back seat. Her mom arrived, and she had some not-so-nice things to say. She was charged with possession of alcohol by a minor, possession of drug paraphernalia, and contributing to the delinquency of a minor for transporting a juvenile to consume marijuana and alcohol.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
